## Checks

- [ ] `cargo test --all-targets` and `cargo test --doc` pass
- [ ] `cargo clippy --all-targets` is quiet
- [ ] `cargo +nightly fmt` leaves nothing to change
- [ ] A test covers the change, and would have failed before it
- [ ] Public items that changed have documentation that says so
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has an entry under `Unreleased`, for anything a user would
      notice
